ns2:course.label: Writing in the Disciplines
ns2:course.description: Teaches students to apply principles of professional communication to the writing tasks typical of specific disciplines or professions. Assignments will vary, depending on the focus of the course, but will include a substantial report or project. Prerequisite: Sophomore standing and completion of campus Composition I requirement.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Prerequisite: Sophomore standing and completion of campus Composition I requirement.
